_comment: Baseline round-trip pass counts per corpus project. Consumed by scripts/roundtrip_delta.py from the roundtrip-verification CI job to detect incremental per-project regressions the absolute-threshold gate misses (issue #1005; audit F3/R9). SEEDED VALUES ARE 'CURRENT STATE', NOT 'KNOWN-GOOD': MediatR 155/157 is exactly the state that surfaced as MinorRegressions on PRs #986/#992 — codifying it here means the alarm treats that as the new floor rather than re-alarming every PR. When a maintainer knows a project should be higher (e.g., the actual known-good MediatR is 157/157), edit this file to the higher value; the next PR that regresses will trigger the alarm. Automated main-branch write-back is tracked in issue #1030.
